title: Level 5 (World Class) - C-19
notes:
West leads the ♥J against 5♦. East wins the first 2 heart tricks and continues with a third round of hearts which South ruffs high as West discards a spade. The contract will be easy if both defenders follow to the first round of diamonds, but West's unexpected discard reveals a problem.

Dummy's remaining diamond honor is cashed (South cannot afford to overtake) and South must find a way back to his hand to draw the rest of East's trump.

Dummy's top spades should be cashed for club discards. If East ruffs the second spade then South can overruff and draw the rest of East's trump. West (who is counted out to 7204 distribution) will be squeezed when South's last diamond is played.

If East follows to the second round of spades, South must hope that East's distribution is 2551 (South has no chance if East is 3550). South must cross to his hand in clubs, blocking the suit, and draw East's trump.

South's last diamond catches West in a jettison squeeze. A spade discard will set up a spade winner in the dummy. If instead West discards a club, then the ♣A is jettisoned from the dummy and South's clubs will win the last 2 tricks. Note that the jettison squeeze only gains a trick in the sense of allowing declarer to get back an unavailable trick in a blocked suit.
